exercises.instruction: Choose the best word from the brackets ( ) to fill the gap.
items: 1 The new model will be ........................ sale in July. (at/on/in)
2 The shop was having a ...................... so I got these shoes at half price. (sale/sales/sell)
3 It's easy to ...................... a sale if the product's good and the price is right. (do/make/give)
5 Sales last month were below our ........................ of €120,000. (gross/target/share)
6 Staff salaries are included in our ........................ costs. (direct/indirect/overhead)
7 Our basic model has a selling ......................... of £28. (cost/margin/price)
8 We estimate that sales ...................... next year will be about 5%. (growth/forecast/volume)

exercises.instruction: Choose the best word to fill each gap from the alternatives given in the box below. There are some words that you don't have to use.
items: 'I've just finished ......................... the new computer we are launching next year. Direct ......................... costs will be $480. I estimate our ......................... to be about $20. That gives ......................... costs of $500. We want a .........................-up of about 20% so the sale price will be $600. That gives a ......................... margin of nearly 17%. Not bad.'

exercises.instruction: Find the answer to each clue. The first and last letters are given in each case.
items: 1 Selling price minus total costs: ........... margin
2 Abbreviation for the variable costs in making goods
3 Selling price minus direct costs: ........... margin
